name: Everbrite Electronics Inc
old_description: Providing Innovative Visual Identification Solutions Since 1927
about:
Everbrite Electronics Inc., headquartered in Greenfield, Wisconsin, was founded in 1927. The company operates as a woman-owned and minority-owned business, certified as a Women's Business Enterprise (WBE) since 2002. It began as a provider of visual identification solutions and has grown into one of the largest full-service signage companies in the United States.

Everbrite designs, manufactures, and installs a range of branding solutions including outdoor signage, indoor signs and displays, menu systems, architectural and drive-thru elements, electronic displays, scoreboards, and LED lighting. The company operates five sales and manufacturing facilities across the United States, offering multi-plant manufacturing capabilities and high-volume production capacity. A network of over 200 preferred installers provides nationwide installation and service, supported by site surveys, code research, permit procurement, and branding guideline development.

The company serves leading brands and retailers worldwide, managing Tier I and Tier II supplier diversity programs. Its client base spans commercial, retail, and institutional sectors, though specific customer names are not disclosed in public materials.

Everbrite differentiates itself through design and engineering excellence, state-of-the-art manufacturing, experienced account management, and consistent financial stability. Its status as the largest Minority/WBE signage company in the U.S. underscores its commitment to supplier diversity and customer satisfaction.
